prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1032; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is pursuing a claim for the losses that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, should likewise be routed through counsel.

We ask that you provide the policy limits for all applicable coverages under the policy that insures the at-fault driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, witness information, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
